findings.title: ZeroDivisionError raised for zero denominator
findings.description: Calculator.divide(4, 0) raises ZeroDivisionError instead of returning an error result.
evidence: python -c "from calc import Calculator; Calculator().divide(4, 0)" -> ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
test_divide_by_zero fails with the same traceback
